in_sanskrit.name: दिनकर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: दिन (Day) + कर (Doer) = संज्ञान (Knowledge) + दाता (Giver) = दिनकर (Sun God)

in_marathi.name: Dinakaran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dinakaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dinakaran is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Dina' meaning 'day' and 'Kara' meaning 'doer' or 'giver'. This name is given to a child born during the daytime or to one who is believed to bring happiness and prosperity to others.
